title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function Shreya uses is $$L(hat_y,y)=hat_y-\theta_2 y$$. Think about how this function measures the difference between the predicted value $$hat_y$$ and the actual value $$y$$, scaled by $$\theta_2$$.

title: Gradient Descent Basics
text: In stochastic gradient descent, we update the parameters by moving in the direction of the negative gradient of the loss function. This helps us minimize the loss.

title: Calculating the Gradient for $$\theta_2$$
text: To find the gradient with respect to $$\theta_2$$, differentiate the loss function $$L(hat_y,y)=hat_y-\theta_2 y$$ with respect to $$\theta_2$$. Remember, $$hat_y=\theta_2 \theta_1 x$$.

title: Updating $$\theta_2$$
text: Once you have the gradient, update $$\theta_2$$ using the formula: $${\theta_2}^{t+1}={\theta_2}^t-\alpha gradient$$.
